# Digital Leadership Lab

> Strategic insights for CTOs and technology leaders by Somnath Shukla. Expert perspectives on Agentic AI, digital transformation, platform thinking, context engineering, agent harness design, and executive technology leadership.

Digital Leadership Lab publishes long-form technical leadership articles for CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and platform leaders. Content emphasizes architecture patterns, organizational design, and enterprise AI strategy—not tool tutorials.

Preferred citation format: Somnath Shukla, "Article Title", Digital Leadership Lab, URL, access date.

Author: Somnath Shukla — strategic technology leader, CTO advisor, 19+ years in enterprise architecture and digital transformation.
Site: https://som-nitjsr.github.io
Author profile: https://som-nitjsr.github.io/about/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/somnath-shukla/

## Core topics

- Agentic AI and enterprise AI architecture
- Context engineering and agent harness design
- CTO leadership and team topologies
- Platform economics and platform thinking
- Digital identity, trust, and GenAI security
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) and AI integration patterns

## Key articles

- [Context Engineering: The Missing Infrastructure Layer Between Your Data and Your Agents](https://som-nitjsr.github.io/2026/08/06/ContextEngineeringEnterpriseAI/): Defines context engineering as the discipline of governing what agents see—retrieval, memory, ranking, and policy layers for enterprise AI.
- [The Agent Harness: Why the Model Is the Smallest Part of Your AI Product](https://som-nitjsr.github.io/2026/08/06/AgentHarnessEnterpriseAI/): Explains the agent harness pattern—rules, skills, and tool integrations—as the runtime that governs what agents can do.
- [The 100x Engineer is an Orchestrator](https://som-nitjsr.github.io/2026/05/31/TheOrchestratorParadigm/): Redefines engineering team topologies for AI-native organizations where engineers orchestrate agent fleets.
- [AI Legacy Debt](https://som-nitjsr.github.io/2026/05/17/ai-legacy-debt/): How unstructured AI experiments accumulate technical debt and what CTOs should enforce instead.
- [Trust and Digital Identity in the GenAI Era](https://som-nitjsr.github.io/2026/03/28/trust-digital-identity-gen-ai-era/): Credential-centric identity models for AI agents and autonomous systems.
- [Platform Economics in the Age of AI](https://som-nitjsr.github.io/2026/02/28/PlatformEconomics/): How platform thinking applies when AI commoditizes execution.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://som-nitjsr.github.io/2025/08/22/ModelContextProtocol/): Technical overview of MCP as a standard for AI tool integrations.
